digest.component_or_area: LLM provider inference and resolution (rebar.llm.config, pydantic-ai integration)
propositions: infer_provider('gemini-2.5-pro') returns 'google_genai', a provider name absent from both pydantic-ai's known providers and ProviderSession._builders, causing provider construction to fail at runtime
model_classes._resolve_target for a bare gemini-* model id composes a qualified provider string using the unmapped 'google_genai' name, which ProviderSession.is_resolvable rejects
_PROVIDER_PREFIXES must map each prefix to a provider name that exists in either _pydantic_ai_known_providers() or ProviderSession._builders to ensure end-to-end resolvability

changing _PROVIDER_PREFIXES gemini mapping from 'google_genai' to 'google' (pydantic-ai's current canonical Gemini Developer API provider name) fixes inference while preserving back-compat shimming in _PAI_PROVIDER_PREFIX
anthropic_model._pai_model accidentally survives via private _PAI_PROVIDER_PREFIX translation table, masking the defect in the runner.run() path for bare cfg.model
google-gla and google-vertex alternatives are deprecated in pydantic-ai v2.0 and would reintroduce future breaks
